jobs.prompt: Knowledge OS lint (read-only): Run `python scripts/knowledge_os_lint.py` against Growth OS (Mac or VPS /opt/hermes/data/obsidian/Growth OS). Write ONLY a new UTC-timestamped report under workspace/drafts/ via knowledge_os_mutation.py receipt wrapper. Do not merge, ingest, archive, promote, or rewrite brain pages. If CRITICAL>0, list paths and stop.

Knowledge OS daily: Load wiki-daily; orient on hot.md + indexes only. Refresh hot.md if focus changed (≤150 words). List unprocessed raw/ from last 48h. Compile with wiki-ingest only when needed, status ≤ CONNECTED/VERIFIED. Update indexes. Append compile-log. Do not set CANONICAL. Do not edit raw/**. Do not treat Business Context or archive/para-migration as SoT.
